title: Network Security Engineer
summary: A network security engineer runs the firewalls, VPNs and network access control (NAC, which checks a device before it joins the network) that protect a company's network. They usually sit in the network or infrastructure team and work with security operations and application teams on rule changes and incidents.
dailyDuties: Review and apply firewall rule change requests
Troubleshoot blocked traffic with logs and packet captures
Set up and fix site-to-site and remote-access VPNs
Onboard devices and fix access failures on the NAC system
Upgrade firewall software and keep configuration backups
Clean up unused or risky firewall rules before audits
Handle escalated tickets and join outage calls

skills.expectation: Design firewall policy, NAT, VPN and network segmentation
Run Palo Alto, Fortinet or Check Point firewalls day to day
Understand routing, VLANs and switching that firewalls sit in
Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS and traffic flows with packet captures
Run NAC such as Cisco ISE or Forescout with 802.1X
Make rule changes through change and incident processes
Explain rule requests and outages to app teams and auditors
Manage Zscaler or Prisma Access for web and private app access
Handle certificates for SSL decryption and VPNs
Send firewall logs to a SIEM and review alerts
Secure Azure or AWS network edges
Patch firewall software and close audit findings
Automate rule reviews and backups with scripts

certifications.why: Networking base most firewall jobs ask for
